name: CLOUDPT
recent: Cloudpoint 完成 1 送 2 免费凭单（Warrants A）的企业活动，265,799,989 张凭单已于 2026 年 11 月 20 日上市。执行董事兼 CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong 在闭门期内外均有交易持股。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收环比增长 31.0%，净利环比增长 109.8%，但净利同比下滑 24.8%。
notable: 完成 1 送 2 免费凭单（Warrants A）发行，265,799,989 张凭单于 2026 年 11 月 20 日上市，行使价 RM0.38。
执行董事兼 CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong 在 2026 年 11 月 16 日至 17 日期间增持公司股份。
2026 年 10 月 20 日举行股东大会，结果已公布。
risks: 执行董事兼 CEO 在闭门期内进行股份交易，公司已就交易意图作出公告。
最新季度净利同比下滑 24.8%，尽管环比大幅回升。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 45.614 百万，环比增长 31.0%，同比微增 0.1%；净利为 MYR 4.142 百万，环比增长 109.8%，同比下滑 24.8%；净利率为 9.1%，高于上一季度的 5.7%。

recent_en: Cloudpoint completed a bonus issue of 265,799,989 free Warrants A on a 1-for-2 basis, with the warrants listed on 20 November 2026. Executive Director and CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong had dealings in shares both within and outside the closed period. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue rose 31.0% QoQ and net income rose 109.8% QoQ, while net income fell 24.8% YoY.
notable_en: Completed bonus issue of 265,799,989 free Warrants A on a 1-for-2 basis, listed on 20 November 2026 with an exercise price of RM0.38.
Executive Director and CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong acquired shares on 16-17 November 2026.
Held a general meeting on 20 October 2026 and announced the outcome.
risks_en: The Executive Director and CEO traded shares during the closed period, with the intention to deal announced.
Latest quarterly net income fell 24.8% YoY, despite a strong QoQ rebound.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 45.614 million, up 31.0% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net income was MYR 4.142 million, up 109.8% QoQ but down 24.8% YoY; net margin was 9.1%, up from 5.7% in the previous quarter.
